lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Withdrawn at third reading, to a small noise of approval from four people who wanted to go home.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Eight months. It will come back as a schedule to a finance act, unamended and undebated, and this time there will be no gallery and no third reading and no me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It passes in the spring, in a schedule, with no naming clause. Everything after that happens in the dark rather than in daylight, which changes nothing about what happens and everything about whether it can be found.
